gaps: No package was installed or renderer executed. Local speed, native dependency compatibility, finished visual quality and synchronization of the approved 78.602449-second narration remain untested.

The one-node ant rig requires species-specific anatomy review. Crawler search found a Texas A&M Imported Fire Ant Model PDF describing two nodes, but that PDF was not read. The attempted older Texas Insects page redirected to a general homepage; do not treat that redirect or the search snippet as checked body evidence.
Anidoodle README says the worked example is 47 seconds, while the source header says 60 seconds and duration comes from imports. Actual duration and the reported repeated-frame issue were not tested.

Some source snapshots are truncated. The older UF insect page and Texas Insects page redirect to general homepages and are excluded from substantive evidence; one guessed Texas A&M identification URL returned 404 before the correct page was retrieved.

Remotion commercial-license eligibility, full dependency-license compatibility and actual install resolution were not assessed. No paid service or new voice generation is required by the proposed first trial, but no all-purpose zero-cost guarantee is made.
Astra ultra appears in the existing local model cache; no new model generation or renderer benchmark was run. The recommendation remains a prototype choice, not a proven production pipeline.

coverage.question: Which candidate has the strongest published code and examples for textured illustrated ants and underground nest scenes?
coverage.reason: Six candidates compared using primary descriptions and code. Ant toolkit is the first prototype recommendation because it has relevant drawing/nest modules and an inspected existing contact sheet; Anidoodle is the illustrated-art backup. No live quality ranking is claimed.

coverage.question: How can the first trial preserve fire-ant biology, reuse the approved narration, and produce 1080x1920 vertical scenes in Deep Six colors?
coverage.reason: Record scientific corrections, new vertical layout and explicit scene timing against the existing audio. Reuse the original MP3; add naked pupae and avoid the demo central mound opening. Exact anatomy and timed output still need the future trial.

coverage.question: What exactly would the first option and one backup require locally, and what costs, license conditions or setup limits apply?
coverage.reason: Declared packages and licensing were read. Local read-only inspection found Node/npm/FFmpeg already installed and neither candidate installed in this project. Recommend a small isolated ant toolkit trial and a separate Playwright-based backup; no installation or spending occurred.

coverage.question: What remains unverified without installing or rendering, and what should a small first trial demonstrate?
coverage.reason: Known documentation/setup limitations and all untested runtime questions are explicit. Recommend a short narration-matched test showing workers move brood through a textured nest before making the full video.

caveats: First choice and backup are caller recommendations based on fit; no new rendering, installation or full audiovisual review was performed.

Existing approved narration remains unchanged. App files, whiteboard and diagrams were not edited. No external paid service, model call, video generation, installation or publishing occurred during this research.
